Main Campus

Main Campus, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan hosts 04 Girls Hostels, a faculty Hostel, a University College for Women and 06 teaching Departments i.e Departments of Law, Political Science, Sociology, Pakistan Studies, International Relations and Psychology, where BS, AD, LLB, LLM, MS/MPhil and PhD Programmes are offered.
